Emma (Marketing): Quick heads-up — scheduling launch post for T-24. Need canonical docs URL and bench blurb. Sam can you confirm changelog PR merge window?
Sam (Engineering): Changelog PR #1340 ready, waiting on perf job. If green I'll merge in ~3h.
Priya (Product): We need non-PR docs path. Recommend /docs/releases/2026-03-surge. Jorge, can you stage that?
Jorge (DevEx): Staging build started. Staging URL: https://staging.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-surge. I'll promote to prod after merge.
Emma (Marketing): For benchmark language we'll use: "~2x throughput improvement on common text-gen workloads (see benchmark notes)". Sam — public-safe bench link?
Sam (Engineering): Will sanitize results and publish at https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03-surge. Will post here when live.
Priya (Product): Webinar on Apr 14. Marketing to collect registrants; HubSpot should tag with "launch-2026-03" and add to nurture "surge-webinar". Jorge, please add webhook.
Jorge (DevEx): Added webhook scoped to landing_page_id; tags only webinar registrants. Test passed.
Emma (Marketing): Go checklist: 1) merge changelog 2) prod docs live 3) public bench link 4) post scheduled 5) hubspot webhook active. React when done.
Sam (Engineering): Merged PR #1340 and triggered release pipeline. ✅
Jorge (DevEx): Prod docs published at https://www.redwood.com/docs/releases/2026-03-surge (CDN ~5m). ✅
Sam (Engineering): Public bench summary live: https://bench.redwood.com/public/release-2026-03-surge-summary. Use conservative wording.
Emma (Marketing): Thanks all — scheduling announcement. Ping if anything breaks.
